raw_html: [[ Paralyzing| Paralyzing ]][[File:Icon tooltip.png|link=|super|10px]]'''[[ Paralyzing| Paralyzing ]]:''' Any creature struck by this weapon must succeed on a DC 17 [[Will save]] or be paralyzed. The target may attempt a new save to end the effect every several seconds; otherwise the paralysis lasts for 1 minute.
